LanguageData.CC_Match_Offer_4: {PEOPLE} have sent a proposal by {WHO}'s hand. They offer {THEIRS} for {OURS}, and would hold it by {RITE}; the colony would call it {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Ans_Yes_4: {OURS} and {THEIRS} are promised. {PEOPLE} have agreed to {WORD}, and want the wedding held by {RITE}. {LIVES}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Ans_No_4: {PEOPLE} won't part with {THEIRS}, not for {OURS} and not this year.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Ans_NoNever_3: {PEOPLE} would not even weigh it. They don't think enough of the colony to give it one of their own, {OURS} or no {OURS}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Ans_Moot_2: {PEOPLE} could not answer as the letter asked. {WHY}
LanguageData.CC_Match_Agreed_Colony_3: {OURS} and {THEIRS} of {PEOPLE} are to be married: {WORD}, by {RITE}. On the day {THEIRS} comes from {TOWN} with {THEIRS_possessive} kin, joins the colony at the gate and is married to {OURS} here, with the kin as guests at the evening's feast before they go home at first light.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Agreed_Theirs_3: {OURS} is promised to {THEIRS} of {PEOPLE}: {WORD}, by {RITE}. On the day {THEIRS} comes to the gate with one of {THEIRS_possessive} kin, and {OURS} walks out to them and leaves for {TOWN}, to be married there and to live there for good.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Arrive_3: {THEIRS} of {PEOPLE} has come in with the wedding's guests and joined the colony at the gate. {OURS} and {THEIRS} will be married today if nothing gets in the way, and the guests will stay to eat. {PEOPLE} would have held it by {RITE}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Arrive_Alone_2: {THEIRS} of {PEOPLE} came in alone and has joined the colony. With no kin here to see it, the wedding to {OURS} will be the colony's own, on a quiet day.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Arrive_Alone_3: No guests came with {THEIRS}, but {THEIRS} came all the same and has joined the colony. The colony will marry {OURS} and {THEIRS} by its own ceremony, once the day is quiet.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Escort_Comes_3: New family for {OURS}: {THEIRS} and one of {PEOPLE}, come from {TOWN}, are walking up to the gate.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Leaves_3: {OURS} said goodbye at the gate and went with {THEIRS} toward {TOWN}. The colony has one less of its own, and {PEOPLE} one more.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Leaves_4: With a last word at the gate, {OURS} left with {THEIRS} for {TOWN}. The wedding will be there, by the ways of {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Wed_3: The wedding is done: {OURS} and {THEIRS} are married, and the kin who came from {TOWN} saw it. {PEOPLE} and the colony are family now.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Wed_4: {OURS} and {THEIRS} said their vows here at the colony, with kin from {TOWN} looking on. It is {WORD} now between {PEOPLE} and the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Match_WedAway_4: A letter from {TOWN} with the news the colony was waiting for: {OURS} and {THEIRS} are married, by {RITE}. {PEOPLE} call the colony family now.
LanguageData.CC_Match_KinGift_4: A season's gift from the kin of {THEIRS}: {GIFT}, set down at the gate by a courier of {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_KinGift_5: {GIFT} came from {TOWN} this season, from the family {THEIRS} left behind there, carried by a courier of {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_KinGift_Away_3: {OURS} hasn't forgotten the colony: {GIFT} came from {TOWN} this season, from {OURS} and {THEIRS}, by a courier of {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_KinGift_Away_4: A courier of {PEOPLE} set down {GIFT} at the gate, the season's gift from {OURS} and {THEIRS} at {TOWN}.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Child_3: {PEOPLE} grieve for {DEAD}, and keep the alliance all the same: {CHILD}, the child of the marriage, is theirs as much as the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_Match_End_Death_3: The alliance with {PEOPLE} ends with {DEAD}. There is no child of the marriage to carry it on.
LanguageData.CC_Match_End_Home_2: {THEIRS} has left the colony and gone back to {PEOPLE}. The marriage alliance ends with it, and neither side holds a grudge.
LanguageData.CC_Match_End_Home_3: {THEIRS} is home among {PEOPLE} again, and the alliance that came with the marriage is over.
LanguageData.CC_Match_End_Parted_3: The marriage between {OURS} and {THEIRS} is over, and the alliance with it. {PEOPLE} will think less of the colony for a while.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Wronged_3: {PEOPLE} gave the colony one of their own, and {NAME} was {WRONG}. The marriage alliance is broken, its pact too, and {HEAD} has taken it up as a grudge to hand down.
LanguageData.CC_Match_Feud_3: With {OLD} gone, the grudge over {NAME} passes to {HEAD}. {PEOPLE} have not forgiven the colony.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Found_Text_Kin: Word has come from the colony's in-laws at {TOWN}, of {DOING}: their people on the road have seen the fires of a camp {WHERE}. {PEOPLE} have made a {KIND} there, near enough to strike at {COLONY}, and the family wanted the colony to hear it from them first.
LanguageData.CC_RaidCamp_Found_Line_Kin: The colony's in-laws at {TOWN} warned of a {KIND} of {PEOPLE} {WHERE}.
